description: NZ Government GNSS CORS is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Geodetic Office. The NZGD2000 Government CORS provides the locations of GNSS Continuously Operating Reference Stations operated by GNS Science under the GeoNet project ( geonet. org. nz). Coordinates are from the LINZ Geodetic Database, in NZGD2000. These are split into several different networks: - PositioNZ - stations predominantly funded by LINZ, with some GeoNet funding. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Geodetic Office. Its tags are New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2025-06-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
